notes: Access tiers: direct HTTP (curl_cffi, homepage/robots/sitemaps only) worked for static assets but every /shop/ category URL returned Akamai '403 Restricted Access' (same static error page); Playwright headless got the same 403 even on the homepage. A real user Chrome session (claude-in-chrome) rendered pages successfully and was used for all extraction below, until partway through this session the site began returning '403 Restricted Access' for EVERY /shop/ request, including URLs that had just succeeded moments earlier (a rate-limit/IP-cooldown block distinct from the earlier bot-block). That cut discovery short for several Christmas sub-pages and the entire Easter branch, which are recorded below as qty:null + MANUAL REVIEW with URLs sourced from the site's own unprotected sitemap (netstorage/sitemaps/shop-sitemap-1.xml.gz) rather than fabricated. Discovery sources used: rendered top nav / mega menu, on-page sidebar refinement links (Halloween and Christmas hub pages), and the shop sitemap for the full category-slug taxonomy. robots.txt has no Claude-specific disallow. Genuine categories found: Halloween (Costumes by age tier, Decor, Treat Bags, Pajamas & Bedding), Christmas (Decor, Tabletop, Bedding, Pajamas, Stockings, Ornaments, plus several unconfirmed), Hanukkah, Thanksgiving, Valentine's Day (all under the site's 'Holidays' hub /shop/holiday/), and Easter (unconfirmed live, sourced from sitemap only). 'All Halloween' (/shop/halloween/all-halloween/, 315 items), 'All Halloween Costumes' (/shop/halloween/all-halloween-costumes/, 152 items), 'All Christmas' (/shop/christmas/christmas-all/, 495 items) and 'All Christmas Bedding & Pajamas' (/shop/christmas/all-christmas-bedding-pajamas/, 195 items) are each genuine PLPs whose own on-page sidebar refinement categories match the narrower sub-category pages captured below as children (confirmed by name, e.g. Decor/Tabletop/Bedding/Pajamas/Treat Bags) - per the shared core's grouping rule these parents are recorded as is_group:true with qty:null (their totals are supersets of the children, not a clean sum, due to normal cross-facet product overlap) so they are not double-counted against the real evidence-backed child rows. Excluded as marketing/navigation/non-PLP: /shop/halloween/ and /shop/christmas/ 'shop by category' tile landing pages (no product grid of their own), /shop/new/holiday-new/ (a 'New Arrivals' filter view titled 'New Arrivals: Kids Christmas', not a category), best-sellers/sale/featured variants (e.g. halloween-best-sellers, easter-best-sellers, holidays-best-sellers, holiday-sale), /pages/halloween/halloween-collections/ (editorial/collections page), 'the-flannel-shop' and 'the-teddy-bear-shop' under /shop/christmas/ (character/theme boutique pages, brand-style listings not genuine holiday sub-categories), gifts-for-christmas/gifts-for-halloween/gifts-for-easter under /shop/gifts/ (ambiguous Gifts-hub cross-filter views, not confirmed as standalone seasonal PLPs), and /shop/holiday/babys-first-holiday/ plus /shop/halloween/babys-first-halloween-feature/ (cross-holiday 'featured' marketing pages, redundant with the per-holiday Baby's First rows already captured). Recommend a follow-up pass once the site's rate-limit clears to confirm qty for the MANUAL REVIEW rows and to verify Easter is live (Sept 2026 is off-season for Easter, so the 403 there may simply be seasonal deactivation rather than a bot/rate-limit block).
